ModMetaData.name: Animal Management
ModMetaData.author: pengin0503
ModMetaData.description:
Shows livestock counts and daily nutrition demand by species and pen, stored feed shared with colonists, spoilage, seasonal pasture growth and conditional 7/15/30-day feed forecasts with stated assumptions. Forecasts are estimates, not guarantees. Information only: no automatic feeding, slaughter or setting changes.
家畜の頭数・日次栄養需要、入植者と共有する備蓄飼料、腐敗、季節ごとの放牧地の成長を表示し、前提条件付きで7・15・30日の飼料収支を予測します。予測は推定です。自動給餌・自動屠殺・設定変更は行いません。
